title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
lineage: SBD > RM > Cass > ? > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jam‑filled June 4 1970 Fillmore show with a smoking St. Stephen jam, tight Midnight Hour/China Cat flow and a soulful It's All Over Now Baby Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that places the guitars up front, delivers crisp drums and lets Pigpen’s organ shine, with only a few brief pauses in the stream. Musically the set is a highlight of the era – a full‑on St. Stephen jam, an adventurous Midnight Hour that weaves into China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, and a moving, mature Baby Blue that many reviewers call the best of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews consistently praise both the musical performance (standout jams and soulful moments) and the high‑quality soundboard recording, yielding an overall exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, front‑center guitars, crisp drums, organ present; a few short pauses but no loss of music, overall clean and well‑balanced mix.

standout_songs: Midnight Hour > China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider > Midnight Hour
It's All Over Now Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set structure with a tight first set and a second set that flows through extended jams, especially the Midnight Hour/China Cat sequence, ending on a soulful Baby Blue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone praised as perfect; his voice noted as adding soul to Baby Blue.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's guitar (old Gibson ES) highlighted as superb and high in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ described as extra churchy, crazy, and a key part of the soulful feel.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums noted as crisp and tight throughout.
